devices.title: Sensors and devices
devices.description: Which sensors this room reads and which devices it drives. The temperature sensor is required; it is what the room is controlled against instead of the air conditioner's internal sensor. Normally-open actuators, which are energised to stop heat rather than to let it through. Leave empty unless a valve behaves backwards.

sensor_lost.title: {room} has lost its temperature sensor
sensor_lost.description: {sensor} is unavailable, so {room} cannot be controlled against a reading. It has fallen back to warming through periodically so it cannot freeze, but it is no longer holding a temperature. Restore the sensor, or reconfigure the room to use a different one.
